subject: PO acceptance & invoice cadence — split-billing proposal for multi-entity rollout
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@crescentsys.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap@crescentsys.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO format, net terms and invoice cadence for Q3 rollout

Hi Rishi,

We're preparing Crescent's purchase order and need to confirm Redwood's PO acceptance window and billing rhythm before we issue. A few specifics from procurement:

- PO fields: require PO number, remit address, tax id (EIN) and a service start date. Is your standard PO template acceptable or do you need custom fields?
- Net terms: procurement prefers net60 but AP will only approve net60 if there's a meaningful early-pay discount. What discount bands can Redwood offer for net45 vs net60?
- Invoice cadence: Crescent runs a centralized AR ledger and prefers weekly consolidated invoices per business unit. Can Redwood deliver weekly consolidated invoices scoped by entity / cost center?

We'd like to close this by end of week so we can push the onboarding forward. I'm copying AP so they can confirm remittance/legal items.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
VP, Procurement — Crescent Systems
Attachments: (none)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@crescentsys.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO format, net terms and invoice cadence for Q3 rollout

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, then proposed tradeoffs: 

- PO fields: We can accept your standard PO if it includes PO number, remit address, EIN, and a service start date. I've attached our redwood_po_template.pdf; if you need a custom field we can map it to our invoice metadata (please flag the exact JSON key).

- Net terms / discount bands: Our standard is net45. For larger annual commitments we offer tiered discounts; short summary: 5% off for net30, 2% off for net45 (standard), and 1% off for net60. We can alternatively do net60 with a 1.5% early-pay rebate if invoices are paid within 15 days. I'll ask finance to confirm final numbers — looping Vanessa.

- Invoice cadence: We can produce consolidated weekly invoices per business unit / cost center. The implementation detail: invoices are generated on Monday for the prior week's usage; to split by cost center we need a line-item mapping at onboarding (two-week lead time). Ben is cc'd for invoice format and file delivery (SFTP/EDI/lockbox).

Proposed options (pick one):
1) Standard: net45, monthly consolidated invoices. No additional discount. Fastest onboarding.
2) Weekly consolidated invoices + net60 with 1.5% early-pay rebate (requires finance sign-off and a signed MOU). Two-week onboarding for cost center mapping.
3) Weekly invoices + net45 + 2% committed-volume discount applied quarterly (requires a 12-month commitment).

If you want, I can draft a 1-page mutual action plan and a revised pricing matrix to reflect the chosen option. Attached pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx shows the bands and thresholds.

Next steps: can you confirm which option Crescent prefers and provide a sample PO file so Ben can validate field mappings?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_po_template.pdf, pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx

On Tue, Jun 15, 2026 at 10:05 AM, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai wrote:
> - Invoice cadence: We can produce consolidated weekly invoices per business unit / cost center. The implementation detail: invoices are generated on Monday for the prior week's usage; to split by cost center we need a line-item mapping at onboarding (two-week lead time). Ben is cc'd for invoice format and file delivery (SFTP/EDI/lockbox).

Thanks Rishi. A couple of clarifying points from AP: 
- Weekly invoices are fine, but we need a single statement per legal entity with line-items tagged by BU code (not separate PDFs per BU). Can your weekly file include an index CSV that lists invoice -> BU-code -> PO number?
- For the early-pay rebate: AP is comfortable with net60 if there's a fixed 1.5% rebate for payments made in 15 days. We will need that in the SOW or an MOU.
- PO delivery: we will send a blanket PO per legal entity that references multiple workstreams. Will Redwood accept a blanket PO with line-item references to subsequent scope docs?

If you can share a short mutual action plan and the MOU language for the early-pay rebate, we can route internally.

Regards,
AP Team
Crescent Systems — Accounts Payable
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@crescentsys.com>, AP Team <ap@crescentsys.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO format, net terms and invoice cadence for Q3 rollout

Thanks — good constructive notes. Attached is a 1-page Mutual Action Plan (mutual_action_plan.docx) and a short MOU clause we can fold into the SOW for the early-pay rebate. Key confirmations below: 

- PO: Redwood accepts a blanket PO per legal entity that references subsequent scope docs. We require the PO to include your PO number and the legal entity tax id to map invoices.

- Invoices: Redwood will deliver one consolidated PDF invoice per legal entity every Monday for the prior week, plus an accompanying index CSV (invoice_index_YYYYMMDD.csv) that maps each line to BU code and PO number. Ben will coordinate SFTP delivery and the CSV schema. Expect a two-week setup after we receive your sample PO.

- Net terms / rebate: We will accept net60 with a 1.5% early-pay rebate for payments made within 15 days. We will include the clause in the SOW and update pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx to reflect the rebate. If Crescent chooses net45 instead, the committed-volume discount (2%) can apply on quarterly invoices for a 12-month minimum consumption commitment.

Action items:
1) Marta/AP: share a sample blanket PO file (PDF or CSV) and confirm the preferred option (net60 + rebate OR net45 + committed discount) by EOD Mon 6/21.
2) Ben: prepare SFTP credentials and sample index CSV schema; draft the invoice layout sample.
3) Vanessa/Finance: please confirm the final rebate math and sign-off on the MOU clause; I'll wait for your OK before we send the SOW language.

I'll stand by for the sample PO — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that speeds things up.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
